interstitial_enabled.description: Interstitial between hunts at all (false = only voluntary rewarded ads).

interstitial_min_sessions.description: First interstitial only after this many hunts in total (0-1000).

interstitial_min_interval_s.description: Seconds since any ad, rewarded too, before an interstitial (0-86400).

offers_enabled.description: The menu pitches paid offers after hunts (false = the store still sells, no popups).

starter_offer_after_hunts.description: Rookie kit (starter_pack) offered from this many hunts (0-1000).

premium_offer_after_hunts.description: Full version offered after an ad break from this many hunts (0-1000).

witching_hour_start.description: Local hour the witching hour starts (0-23). In-game texts say 23:00.

witching_hour_end.description: Local hour the witching hour ends (0-23).

min_version_code.description: Builds with a lower versionCode see the 'update' card in the menu (0 = nobody).

season_event.description: Seasonal event in force (halloween); read by the game, no seasonal content uses it yet.
